newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTUGAL NAME PRELIMINARY SQUAD TO FACE UKRAINE, ALBANIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGAL NAME PRELIMINARY SQUAD TO FACE UKRAINE, ALBANIA.

text.p: League champions Porto provide five players in a preliminary 21-man squad for next month's World Cup qualifiers against Ukraine and Albania, the Portuguese Football Federation said on Friday.
National coach Artur Jorge included midfielders Sergio Conceicao of Porto and Jose Taira Pereira of Salamanca in the squad for the first time.
Portugal, who drew 0-0 with Armenia in their first European group nine qualifier in August, meet Ukraine in Kiev on October 5 and Albania in Tirana on October 9.
Defenders - Jorge Costa, Paulinho Santos, Helder Cristovao, Carlos Secretario, Fernando Couto, Rui Jorge, Paulo Madeira, Fernando Nelson Alves.
Midfielders - Sergio Conceicao, Luis Figo, Ricardo Sa Pinto, Rui Costa, Oceano Cruz, Jose Taira Pereira, Nuno Rocha (Capucho), Paulo Bento.
Forwards - Antonio Folha, Paulo Alves, Joao Pinto.
